summary.experiment_summary: The experiment 'EXP-GEN-0036' investigates whether the complete execution of the Science-Suite protocol generates comprehensive and internally consistent diagnostic artifacts for all registered sub-protocols under shared provenance. It ran 180 iterations with seeds 42-51, each with 10 runs, totaling 180 runs. All metrics across sub-protocols show deterministic statistics with zero standard deviation, indicating consistent results across runs. The temporal horizons analysis shows discrepancies with small mean values, suggesting minor inconsistencies in temporal data. The time metrics show varying ticks per second, indicating performance fluctuations. The inter-spike interval analysis for 'ping:recurrence_on' shows a mean of 1.9375 with a standard deviation of 0.5555, indicating variability in spike timing. The experiment's results are internally consistent but require semantic validation and human review for scientific interpretation.
